basic_profile.bio: I'm a recent finance graduate based in Toronto, Canada, currently working as a junior financial analyst. I have a keen interest in real estate and stock trading, and I'm trying to learn as much as possible about these fields. I dislike hidden fees and unexpected changes in financial services, as they disrupt my financial planning. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 7-10 PM EST. I'm single and enjoy spending my weekends exploring new investment opportunities or hiking in the nearby national parks.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My background is in finance, having completed a Bachelor's degree in Financial Economics. I've been self-teaching stock trading through online resources and communities like Reddit to complement my formal education.
